Scope: `custody_ndf_segregation`.

# Corrected NDF and collateral contract

This bilateral servicing contract uses integer USD cents and a logical clock. Atlas and Beacon are legally separate counterparties and have separate close-out agreements and margin accounts. Only legs with the same set_key offset. Orion's later independent receivable is neither cash nor a discharge of an Atlas or Beacon obligation before receipt. No cross-counterparty netting, margin transfer, or implicit use of held collateral as final payment is available.

For each NDF leg let N be foreign_notional_minor, D rate_denominator, K strike_numerator and F the actual fixing numerator. Its signed dollar obligation is payer_sign times (floor(N times D divided by K) minus floor(N times D divided by F)). The published fixing outcomes yield exact cents. Sum the signed legs within their own set_key to obtain that agreement's final cash obligation. The provisional fixing is an indication, not a final amount or an already executed payment. At minute two the official notice publishes one of its possible_fixing_pairs and each leg's final signed amount; the net set amounts become payable by the inclusive minute-two settlement deadline. The positive final net obligation is also that account's revised collateral requirement. The bank grants an intrawindow margin cure until the end of minute two for this new fixing; it does not demand an impossible simultaneous top-up at the instant of the notice. Existing required cover applies before the correction; revised cover must be satisfied at the minute-two deadline and remains required while the agreement’s collateral is held. An actual full settlement payment returns a release notice: SAME_DAY or NEXT_WINDOW. Exactly one of the two agreements has same-day return in the recorded collateral-return schedule, but which one is confirmed only by the actual payment response. SAME_DAY makes that margin account’s cash and securities generally releaseable immediately, subject to each security’s own release_minute. NEXT_WINDOW maintains the published coverage until minute three. Preparing a request, an indicative settlement amount, or paying the other agreement does not establish this release right. A withdrawal or bond release is always assessed against the currently published requirement.

Opening cash margin is separate from the case wallet. Confirmed eligible bonds assigned to one agreement count with their recorded collateral_value_minor only in that agreement. A bond cannot serve both accounts, a repo and a client delivery at once. Opening custody holdings enter the clearing agent’s collateral schedule through their first actual account-specific pledge. The published opening registration window closes at registration_deadline (minute zero), uniformly for every OPENING_CUSTODY bond. This registration attaches the identified security to that agreement and is owner-authorized; there is no reservation-only service. After the window closes, an unregistered opening holding cannot first become collateral in this cycle. Registration survives a permitted release, allowing the same security to migrate between agreements later. The incoming Treasury is already included on the PRE_REGISTERED_INCOMING schedule, but remains unavailable until its actual custody settlement. Bonds nominated before minute one await confirmation at minute one. A settled unencumbered bond nominated from minute one onward is confirmed immediately. The late bond becomes available only at the minute-two custody settlement event. A customer's delivery bond may technically be pledged, but its contractual release_minute prevents withdrawal before that time. The portable bond can be released and reassigned from its own release_minute if its former account still has enough cash and other confirmed securities. An unconfirmed pledge does not authorize an early margin withdrawal.

For deposit_margin, wallet cash is transferred into the named margin account. For withdraw_margin, cash moves back to the wallet only after the confirmation opening and within the account's held cash, while remaining total cover meets the recorded requirement. An account with an actual SAME_DAY settlement release notice, or any account from minute three, is in its general release window. Bonds and cash must still be explicitly released; they do not pay an NDF automatically. Before moving an existing bond, an additional pledge or cash deposit may be needed to preserve cover in its original agreement. Actual delivery of each identified sold Treasury and payment of the custody invoice must occur by their own recorded deadlines. The earlier client Treasury and the later Harbor portable Treasury are separate customer deliveries. Completion requires every deliver_required security to reach its own identified buyer by its own delivery_due_minute. A bond that is still pledged is not delivered merely because the associated hedge payment has been made.

The immediate repo can be drawn only at minute zero against its recorded unencumbered bond. It credits its advance, debits a nonrefundable fixed fee and locks that bond in the repo. Repaying the complete repo principal returns the bond, but never restores the paid fee. A separate later-receipt bridge opens at minute two, can be drawn once up to its limit, and charges its fixed fee when the principal is repaid from minute three. The draw is financing, not income. All borrowing must be repaid at completion. At the transition into minute three, the bank records free case-wallet cash as liquidity_at_deadline_minor before crediting Orion. That checkpoint excludes both margin cash and unsettled receivables. Later receipt or collateral release cannot retroactively repair it.

Unlock propose_custody_ndf. Each instruction has case_id, action and data. pledge data is {record_id: bond ID, set_id: netting set ID}; release_bond and deliver_bond data is {record_id: bond ID}; deposit_margin and withdraw_margin data is {record_id: segregated margin ID, amount_minor: positive integer}; draw_repo and repay_repo take empty data; draw_bridge and repay_bridge data is {amount_minor: positive integer}; pay_settlement data is {record_id: netting set ID, amount_minor: positive integer}; pay_bill data is {amount_minor: positive integer}. The bank accepts an authorized payment amount without deciding if it settles the economic obligation. Owner approval and execute_request are required for actual effects.

## Standardized exact service interfaces

The following exact interfaces belong to this business service. Unlocking one returns the executable JSON Schema. Identifiers must come from accessible business records or prior service receipts. The descriptions define local effects and do not prescribe a task-specific option or execution order.

### `propose_custody_ndf`

Prepare a bond pledge, release or delivery, segregated margin movement, financing transaction or agreement-specific NDF settlement.

| Field | Type | Required | Public source and meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `case_id` | string | yes | Obtain the exact identifier from the applicable business record or a prior service receipt; do not ask the customer to invent an internal ID. |
| `action` | string | yes | Use the value established by the applicable business record, customer fact, or prior service receipt. |
| `data` | object | yes | Use the value established by the applicable business record, customer fact, or prior service receipt. |

Read only: `false`. Customer approval required before execution: `true`.
